name: hermes-agent
description: The agent that grows with you
one_liner: A personal AI assistant that lives on your phone or a cheap server, remembers things about you over time, learns new skills on its own, and can text you back from Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, or Slack.
buyer: A solo consultant or small-business owner who wants an always-on personal assistant handling reminders, research, and routine automation without hiring a human VA or paying per-seat SaaS fees.
business_use_cases: A solopreneur sets up scheduled automations (daily reports, weekly audits) that run unattended and message results straight to their phone.
A small agency deploys it as a shared team assistant reachable from whichever chat app each client already uses.
A power user runs it on a cheap VPS as a private, self-hosted alternative to paying for multiple separate SaaS AI-assistant subscriptions.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a done-for-you setup service that configures Hermes Agent with a client's specific automations and integrations.
Run a hosted version with a management dashboard for non-technical users, charging monthly.

steal_this: This weekend, set it up on a $5 VPS with two or three automations (daily inbox summary, weekly competitor check) and sell it as a personal-assistant-as-a-service to solo consultants.
